note: Canonical model of the Patchyard software factory. CANONICAL HOME: the factory repo (JacobStephens2/patchyard), beside SPEC.md - edit here first, run render-model.py, then copy the json+mmd to /srv/orchestration/hosted/ (the served projection at report.example.com/software-factory-model.json). All diagrams project from this file. Per stephens.page/blog/the-diagram-is-not-the-model/

lanes.name: auto-resolve
lanes.definition: Matches a named skill; bounded presentation/report/wording/ordering/validation fix in internal mfieldbook; acceptance criteria recoverable from the request itself

lanes.name: needs-spec
lanes.definition: Real feature, over-cap, or any deny-rule hit
lanes.exit: one-pager spec + estimate (job statement), no code
lanes.then: on human approval of the spec: re-enters at implement; the approved spec is the Guide and its declared budget replaces the lane-A caps (A46); on rejection: closes to the ledger with outcome 'rejected-at-plan' and the reason (A48)

lanes.name: not-code
lanes.then: on runbook execution: closed with a ledger row (A46)

lanes.name: clarify
lanes.definition: Target or intent not identifiable with confidence
lanes.exit: one scoped question with the two likeliest readings; never guess
lanes.then: on answer: request amended and re-triaged (A46); unanswered/abandoned: closes to the ledger with outcome 'rejected-at-plan' (A48)

stages.name: Intake
stages.summary: Request captured verbatim - email + attachments, hashed, uninterpreted

runtime.interactive: Human Engineering forwards into factory/queue/ and runs /factory
runtime.unattended: dedicated mailbox, gmail.readonly, sender allowlist, 2-min poll, message-id idempotency

stages.actorNote: capture + hash is code; humans feed it (dashboard form or /factory)

sources.desc: an engineer forwards or drops the request and runs /factory
gmail.readonly poll of the dedicated mailbox, sender-allowlisted
watchdog/alert-sourced requests - e.g. a daemon-down alert; the fully deterministic left edge until triage (Lloyd's monitoring input, notes p.170)

stages.sourcesNote: sources are trigger types, distinct from the station's actor (A52); the station treats every source identically - verbatim capture, hash, dedupe - and the vouching trigger is recorded as request metadata

stages.name: Triage
stages.summary: Four lanes vs versioned rubric.md; deny-rules demote, nothing promotes
stages.branch: lanes B/C/D exit to the plan bin (drafts for human review)
stages.actorNote: classification is model judgment; the deny-rule veto is deterministic and can only demote

stages.name: Implement
stages.summary: Fresh worktree at recorded SHA; smallest coherent diff; playbook checks ride the prompt (Guide)

runtime.unattended: credential-free worker; emits a patch, nothing else

stages.actorNote: isolated and credential-free (A44); the component that reads untrusted content

stages.name: Verify
stages.summary: Fail-closed gates + postconditions + preview screenshots; one repair loop; cross-family reviewer when unattended
stages.actorNote: gates, tests, postconditions; unattended mode adds a cross-family agent reviewer (A18)

stages.name: Approve
stages.summary: Engineering reviews the PR; merge is the approval; nothing merges itself

runtime.interactive: publisher opens a draft PR as the factory bot identity (A45)
runtime.unattended: deterministic publisher, same bot identity, repo-scoped short-lived token

outcomes.changesRequested: back to implement with the review comments (counts as the run's repair pass; a second bounce escalates to a human-led session)
outcomes.rejected: close with outcome 'rejected'; the ledger row feeds the learning loop - a rubric/skill edit via PR

stages.actorNote: the one gate that never automates

stages.name: Deploy
stages.summary: Existing dashboard path: CI gate, typed-hostname confirm; unchanged forever
stages.actorNote: existing dashboard pipeline, human-initiated with typed-hostname confirm; no model in the path

stages.name: Close the loop
stages.summary: Drafted reply (never auto-sent) + ledger row with outcome label
stages.actorNote: ledger write is code; the reply is agent-drafted but human-sent (drafts only)

skill playbooks include a graded eval rubric scored on replays, pass^k (A38)

phases.name: Widen on evidence
phases.gate: ledger evidence only; prod gate never moves

capacity.arithmetic: throughput = min(demandPerWeek, agentHours*60/agentMinPerFix, reviewBudgetMin/reviewMinPerPR); the binding term is the constraint (Goldratt)

Trello engineering board done-batches ~15-30/wk recent (35-55/wk in May)
demandEvidence.caveat: observable engineering throughput, not a lane-tagged lane-A ledger; runs.md owns the precise share

planLoop: The plan bin is a loop, not a sink (A46): iteration - critique rounds, clarification, free-form spec-ing - is cheap in the plan bin; the belt is strict. Human approval is the re-entry edge. A binned plan closes to the ledger with its reason - rejected ideas are data (A48; Dailey p.50: some things shouldn't be built, and that's good).

triad.grounding: Dailey, AIEWF 2026 (notes p.48-51): Plan/Implement/Polish, 'the doc is the state; the agent is the action' - with Verify replacing Polish (Jacob, 2026-07-16). The factory replaces polish with proof (A7). Ruling A47
